title: Empty Fourier coefficient of the conjunction function
statement: Let $w$ be a nonnegative integer, and define $f:\{-1,1\}^w\to\{-1,1\}$ to equal $-1$ at the all-$-1$ input and $1$ elsewhere. Its empty-set Fourier coefficient, computed with uniform expectation on the cube, is $\widehat f(\varnothing)=1-2\cdot 2^{-w}$.
hypotheses_covered: The width $w$ is a nonnegative integer
The function equals $-1$ only at the all-$-1$ input and equals $1$ elsewhere
The Fourier index is the empty set
